# Compliance Check - Internal Control and AML

**Ref ID:** RSK-BATCH-077
**Date:** 2026-04-15

This document details the necessary actions for ensuring robust internal controls and compliance standards within the bank.

## Key Actions Required:

*   Investigate the internal control standard update.
*   Review the internal control for strategy 2026.
*   Monitor the internal control standard update.
*   Review the AML detection standard update.
*   Monitor the legal risks based on audit findings.
